title: Eco-friendly nanobioengineered CuO platform mediated through Ficus religiosa latex for malathion detection
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00234F, Paper
Kshitij RB Singh, Pooja Singh, Shyam S. Pandey
A biogenic CuO nanoparticle-based biosensor, synthesized using Ficus religiosa latex, enables highly sensitive, rapid, and eco-friendly electrochemical detection of malathion.
